200.title: NATO chief calls Polish airspace violation 'dangerous incident'
200.summary: NATO chief calls Polish airspace violation 'dangerous incident' NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte described last week's violation of Polish airspace as a "dangerous incident" on Monday, stating that Russia was its source and that the authorities must determine whether it was deliberate.
200.body: NATO chief calls Polish airspace violation 'dangerous incident' NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte described last week's violation of Polish airspace as a "dangerous incident" on Monday, stating that Russia was its source and that the authorities must determine whether it was deliberate. Addressing the plenary sitting of the 72nd annual session of the NATO Parliamentary Assembly in Berlin, Rutte said "It is clear that this is a dangerous incident. In response to the incident, Polish Defence Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz announced he would ask Rutte to allocate additional forces and assets to Operation Eastern Sentry, a mission aimed at bolstering NATO's eastern flank.

200.title: Polish Ambassador and ICC President unveil artwork donation to International Criminal Court
200.summary: Polish Ambassador and ICC President unveil artwork donation to International Criminal Court Press Release: 23 November 2026 Polish Ambassador and ICC President unveil artwork donation to International Criminal Court Image The artwork donated by Poland to the Court, unveiled at ICC headquarters in The Hague on 20 November 2026 ©ICC-CPI On 20 November 2026, H.E.
200.body: Polish Ambassador and ICC President unveil artwork donation to International Criminal Court Press Release: 23 November 2026 Polish Ambassador and ICC President unveil artwork donation to International Criminal Court Image The artwork donated by Poland to the Court, unveiled at ICC headquarters in The Hague on 20 November 2026 ©ICC-CPI On 20 November 2026, H.E. Ms Margareta Kassangana, Ambassador of the Republic of Poland to the Kingdom of the Netherlands and Vice-President of the Assembly of States Parties, together with Judge Tomoko Akane, President of the International Criminal Court (ICC), unveiled a bust of Polish jurist Rafał Lemkin at the ICC headquarters in The Hague, The Netherlands. His legacy remains closely connected to the mission and values of the International Criminal Court. The donation also reflects Poland's support for the Court's institutional and commemorative role in promoting accountability for the gravest crimes of concern to the international community.

600.body: News World Polish ski jumpers score only 4 points at season start — Interia Sport UA.NEWS 23 November 2026 14:38 --> In Lillehammer, Norway, Polish ski jumpers earned four ranking points after the first two individual men's events of the World Cup season.
